title: Pegboard fit test: the shared hook peg + pin
subtitle: Built only from tools/pegboard.py, the pegs every catalog part uses · hung on your board (Menards 3/16" white, 1" grid) · X out from the board, Z up · mm

Hook leg rise above hole centre

scale_note: Real size. Peg sizes come from your steel hook (5.53 mm wire). The board is your Menards 3/16" panel at retailer-listed sizes (9/32" holes, 0.155" thick); caliper it to confirm.
notes: Print this before any other catalog part (PETG, on its side, no supports, about 15 minutes). Hang it: tilt it, push the hook up through a hole, swing the bottom in so the pin drops into the hole below. Check: (1) does it go on and come off like the steel hook? (2) snug, loose, or tight? On your board the pegs have 0.8 mm per side in the holes, so expect a little play; the pegs can grow to ~6.5 mm if it's sloppy. (3) does the pin seat fully? If anything is off, the peg sizes change in one place (PegStyle in tools/pegboard.py) and every catalog part follows.
